description: In a busy restaurant kitchen, a young head chef in a white jacket tastes a spoonful from a plate of seared scallops on yellow purée and gives an approving smile. Beside him a young cook in a navy apron pumps both fists in the air and laughs with relief. The chef lowers the spoon, smiles at the plate and slides it toward the cook, who claps his hands together, beaming. Copper pans hang on a rail, green pendant lamps light cream tiles, and other cooks work in the background.

taps.phrase: to punch the air with joy
